sources.source: Planning Data tree preservation zone dataset
sources.authority: MHCLG Planning Data / participating local planning authorities
sources.verified_fact: The official dataset lists 94,023 tree preservation zones from 79 providers; collector and new-data dates are 2026-07-22.
sources.quality_effect: The platform warns that coverage is incomplete and includes some MHCLG-created data, so a zone may support screening only when its authoritative order linkage and exact geometry are retained.

sources.verified_fact: The official dataset lists 44,373 ancient woodlands, with collector date 2026-07-22 and new data last found on 2026-03-21; its origin is authoritative.
sources.quality_effect: Ancient woodland is a strong environmental constraint, but the platform-wide incompleteness warning requires fail-closed treatment where coverage or spatial relation is uncertain.

sources.source: Planning Data site of special scientific interest dataset
sources.verified_fact: The dataset lists 4,128 SSSIs; the collector last ran on 2026-07-22 and new data was last found on 2026-04-23.
sources.quality_effect: SSSI intersection can support protected-site screening, but the stated mixed-origin condition blocks treating the platform geometry as the sole definitive planning decision record.

sources.verified_fact: The dataset lists 20,150 scheduled monuments; collector and new-data dates are 2026-07-22, and the underlying statutory list is maintained by Historic England.
sources.quality_effect: A monument relation is a high-impact heritage constraint, but the platform notes some MHCLG-created data and directs users to Historic England for the most current GIS data.

sources.source: Planning Data local nature reserve dataset
sources.authority: Natural England / local authorities / MHCLG Planning Data
sources.verified_fact: The dataset lists 1,727 local nature reserves from 2 providers; collector date is 2026-07-22 and new data was last found on 2026-06-19.
sources.quality_effect: A declared reserve can support environmental constraint screening, but the mixed-origin note requires the designation and geometry to be verified before parcel scoring.

sources.source: Planning Data national nature reserve dataset
sources.verified_fact: The dataset lists 224 national nature reserves; collector and new-data dates are 2026-07-22.
sources.quality_effect: National reserve status is a strong environmental signal, but the platform's mixed-origin statement prevents sole-source high-confidence parcel penalties.

sources.source: Planning Data development plan document dataset
sources.verified_fact: The dataset lists 2,686 plan documents, with one provider; collector date is 2026-07-16 and new data was last found on 2026-02-10.
sources.quality_effect: Document links can support plan-policy evidence, but the dataset is incomplete and MHCLG-created, so the linked authority document and current plan status must be checked before scoring.

sources.source: GOV.UK approved plan-data standard under the 2026 regulations
sources.authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_fact: The guidance was published on 2026-04-16, updated on 2026-05-13, and relates to regulations commencing on 2026-05-07; authorities must follow the standard for specified plan timetables and local-plan housing requirements.
sources.quality_effect: Adds a legal and process-status gate for new-system plan evidence; it does not provide parcel geometry or a growth score by itself.

examples.promotion_reason: It is an environmental constraint example and was not spatially related to a canonical parcel in this environment.
